title: India Boosts Battery Making: What the Expanded PLI Scheme Means for You
description: The government has expanded its Production Linked Incentive (PLI) scheme for making advanced batteries in India. This new phase offers an additional ₹10,000 c.

faq.q: What are Advanced Chemistry Cell (ACC) batteries?
faq.a: ACC batteries are the new generation of energy storage devices that can store electric energy as chemical energy and convert it back to electric energy when needed. They are crucial for electric vehicles and large-scale energy storage.

faq.q: How much money is involved in this scheme?
faq.a: The initial PLI scheme for ACC batteries had an outlay of ₹18,100 crore over five years. With the recent announcement, an additional ₹10,000 crore has been allocated, bringing the total incentive pool to roughly ₹28,100 crore for this crucial sector.

faq.q: Which companies are benefiting from this scheme?
faq.a: Several Indian and international companies have already committed to setting up battery manufacturing facilities under the initial phase of the scheme. Specific names are announced by the government after a competitive bidding process.

faq.q: Will this make electric vehicles cheaper right away?
faq.a: The impact on EV prices will likely be gradual. As local battery production scales up and costs come down due to economies of scale and local sourcing, these savings can eventually be passed on to consumers.
